title: 第1043章 墨老和贺兰2第1042章 墨老和贺兰
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风说道：“三人小组会放你走？”
墨恒说道：“不放我走，他们又能做什么？他们总不能让决议会帮我去复仇吧？
我走了，对他们也是好事，毕竟安亮什么事情都会和我商议，那样，决议会在我眼中，就没有什么秘密。”
贾诩说道：“也就是说，你其实几乎知道决议会的所有秘密？”
墨恒说道：“差不多吧，你想知道什么？”
萧风说道：“我想知道他的一切，这个新出来的三人小组，到底是什么样的组织，同时，
决议会现在的实力，到底怎么样。”
墨恒看向萧风，缓缓说道：“我不知道你说的一切是什么，我想说，三人小组的力量，
比我们看到的要强，在他们覆灭魔神组织后，原本有些人是想浑水摸鱼的，趁着决议会实力下滑，
准备对决议会做什么，但是他们发现，很多在其他地方的势力，都开始向决议会靠拢，而且这些势力，
也只是一部分，不是全部，那些动心思的人，都被这个劝退了，至于三人小组，他们的人，
谁也说不清楚，就拿墨灵来说，我也最后才知道，他是三人小组的人，决议会中，有多少是这样的人，
谁也不知道，安亮和薛英柏，想要反抗，但是，他们现在也没有什么真正值得信任的人，
三人小组的威慑力，在于那些未知的事情，而不是摆在台面上的事情，魔神组织，他们可以做得更好，
但是还是要等安亮他们陷入绝境，他们才出手，你们说，他们这样的目的是什么？
不过就是想要快速地削弱安亮和薛英柏手中的力量罢了，一个名正言顺的机会。”
萧风不解，说道：“那都是决议会的力量，削弱安亮和薛英柏的力量，对他来说，有什么好处？”
墨恒说道：“好处很简单，就是能快速地重新掌控决议会，同时敲打安亮和薛英柏，
告诉他们这里谁说了算。”
贾诩说道：“决议会的禁地，到底是个什么地方?”
墨恒说道：“其实所谓的禁地，只是一个小的世界，看着不大，但是里面还是挺大的，
这里的人，是被三人小组的人选择的，他们会一直在里面，直到三人小组说，需要些人，
他们才会出来，不过，我现在知道的消息是，禁地中，几乎是没有人了，三人小组都将人调出来了，
平常的禁地，只有我们看到的那个一点地方，只有进去找到机关，才能进入真正的禁地，
我没有进去过，具体里面是什么情况，我也不知道。”
贾诩说道：“他们说的封印是什么？”
墨恒说道：“这个我还真不知道，估计只有三人小组的人，才知道，里面真正是什么，
不过，从我的推断，里面封印的人，或者物，肯定是和决议会的建立有关系，要不然也不会那么多人去探查。”
萧风说道：“那现在决议会下一步动作是什么？”
content_en:
Xiao Feng said: "Will the three-person team let you go?"
Mo Heng said: "If they don't let me go, what can they do? They can't let the Resolution Council help me take revenge, can they?
It's also a good thing for them that I'm gone. After all, An Liang will discuss everything with me. That way, the decision will be in my eyes and there will be no secrets. "
Jia Xu said: "In other words, you actually know almost all the secrets of the resolution meeting?"
Mo Heng said: "Absolutely. What do you want to know?"
Xiao Feng said: "I want to know everything about him. What kind of organization is this new three-person team? At the same time,
What is the current strength of the resolution meeting? "
Mo Heng looked at Xiao Feng and said slowly: "I don't know what you are talking about. What I want to say is that the power of a three-person team,
It's stronger than what we saw. After they destroyed the Demon God Organization, some people originally wanted to fish in troubled waters. They took advantage of the decision's decline in strength.
They were preparing to do something to the Resolution Conference, but they found that many forces in other places began to move closer to the Resolution Conference, and these forces,
Only some, not all, those who were interested were dissuaded by this. As for the three-person group, their people,
No one can tell. Take Mo Ling as an example. I finally found out that he was a member of a three-person group. How many people were like this in the resolution meeting?
No one knows that An Liang and Xue Yingbai want to resist, but they have no one really trustworthy now.
The deterrence of the three-person team lies in the unknown things, not the things on the table. The Demon God Organization, they can do better,
But they still have to wait until An Liang and the others are in dire straits before they take action. What do you think their purpose is?
They just wanted to quickly weaken the power in the hands of An Liang and Xue Yingbai. It was a legitimate opportunity. "
Xiao Feng was puzzled and said: "That's all the power of the resolution meeting. What's the benefit to him of weakening the power of An Liang and Xue Yingbai?"
Mo Heng said: "The advantage is very simple, that is, we can quickly regain control of the decision-making meeting and beat An Liang and Xue Yingbai at the same time.
Tell them who has the final say here. "
Jia Xu said: "What exactly is the forbidden area of the resolution meeting?"
Mo Heng said: "Actually, the so-called forbidden land is just a small world. It doesn't look big, but it's still quite big inside.
The people here are chosen by the three-person team, and they will stay there until the three-person team says they need some people.
They will come out. However, the news I know now is that there is almost no one in the forbidden area. The three-person team has transferred people out.
Ordinary forbidden areas only include the little area we see. Only by going in and finding the mechanism can we enter the real forbidden area.
I've never been inside, and I don't know exactly what's going on inside. "
Jia Xu said: "What is the seal they are talking about?"
Mo Heng said: "I really don't know this. I guess only the three-person team knows what's really inside.
However, from my inference, the people or things sealed inside must be related to the establishment of the resolution meeting, otherwise there would not be so many people investigating. "
Xiao Feng said: "What is the next step of the decision-making committee now?"
